refreshNotes:
All-new G90 M5 sedan and G99 M5 Touring debut for MY2025 as BMW's first electrified (PHEV) M5. 4.4L S68 V8 + e-motor = 717 hp / 738 lb-ft, 14.8 kWh battery, ~25-27 mi EPA EV range. Sedan MSRP $119,500; Touring MSRP $121,500 (excluding destination).

Sources:
- https://www.autoblog.com/reviews/2025-bmw-m5-touring-wagon-phev-review
